name: Clock Signal
description:
Clock Signal (CLK) is an open-source latency-focused emulator for classic 8-bit and 16-bit computer and console platforms. It emphasizes cycle-accurate audio-video synchronization and minimal input lag.

Features:
- Emulation for Amiga, Apple II, Atari ST, Commodore 64, MSX, ZX81, and ZX Spectrum
- Console support for ColecoVision, Master System, and Game Gear
- Sophisticated CRT display simulation with curvature, bloom, and scanlines
- Real-time cycle-by-cycle hardware emulation minimizing processing latency
- Clean modern interface with drag-and-drop disk and tape image loading
